dataset.name: WTC 1 V9C official ringing-aware yield-method audit and conditional revalidation
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9B, audit official NIST repositories for raw M26/C80 high-rate records, implement the published third-order polynomial yield procedure on the immutable V9B digitized curves, and revalidate yield and tensile strengths without changing the V9B tensile estimator. A non-eroding OpenRadioss coupon remains conditional on every revalidation gate. Failure deletion, facade impact, whole-aircraft, global tower, thermal and Blender work are prohibited in V9C.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A statement, equation, table value or curve in an identified official NIST source.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A NIST modelling or signal-reduction choice; not a new material measurement.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No local-archive claim is introduced and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: A predeclared numerical implementation choice needed where the publication does not fully specify an algorithm.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic calculation from immutable V9B digitized traces using the predeclared V9C method.
evidence_policy.unknown: Raw channels, exact per-test elastic modulus and other information absent from the public sources audited here.

locations: Section 4.2.2 steps 1 to 11, report pages 81 to 82
direct_facts: The high-rate apparatus acquired about 5000 points per test from load, displacement, specimen-section strain, grip-end strain and time channels.
The corrected load signal was constructed by aligning the grip-section load curve with the mean of the piezoelectric load-washer signal.
For ringing cases, NIST fitted a third-order polynomial over 1 percent through 5 percent strain and intersected it with a line parallel to the linear-elastic curve at 1 percent offset.
NIST defined tensile strength as maximum load divided by original test-section area.
The report states that ringing in the high-rate stress signal was not completely eliminated.

uses: independent text comparison of the same high-rate analysis steps
confirmation that the final report retained the third-order polynomial method

sources.finding: The public WTC collection indexes NCSTAR reports and media, but the targeted search did not expose specimen-level M26/C80 raw load, strain and time files.
A machine-readable WTC-steel dataset is publicly catalogued for high-temperature quasistatic constitutive data, but it is not the room-temperature high-rate M26/C80 raw dataset required here.
The ESIS index identifies P7-00, Procedure for Dynamic Tensile Tests, under TC5; the targeted public search did not locate the complete procedure or WTC-specific raw records.

public_raw_data_audit.audit_interpretation: The report documents the channel types and reduction sequence, but the specimen-level raw channels needed to reproduce the corrected load signal and its uncertainty were not located in the audited public NIST indexes.

ringing_aware_method.input_curves: Immutable V9B engineering-strain/engineering-stress CSV files extracted from NCSTAR 1-3D Figures A-28 and A-48.
ringing_aware_method.conversion: Before fitting, convert every retained point to true strain ln(1+e_engineering) and true stress sigma_engineering*(1+e_engineering).
ringing_aware_method.fit_model: Unweighted ordinary least-squares third-order polynomial. Scale the fit-window coordinate linearly to [-1,1] for numerical conditioning; this does not change the cubic polynomial space.
ringing_aware_method.elastic_modulus_status: predeclared sensitivity hypothesis because the plotted axes do not resolve the per-test elastic slope and raw corrected channels were not found
ringing_aware_method.yield_selection: Select the smallest real intersection in the closed fit window for which the cubic slope is below E. Report all real in-window roots and fail identification if the selected root is not unique under that rule. Report the intersection in true stress and convert it back to engineering-equivalent stress sigma_true/exp(epsilon_true) for comparison with the tabulated engineering-stress strength.
ringing_aware_method.tensile_strength: Retain the V9B maximum digitized engineering stress without smoothing or filtering, because NCSTAR 1-3D defines TS from maximum load.
ringing_aware_method.reference_intervals: Use the unchanged V9B Table A-12/A-14 intervals; relative error is zero within an interval and otherwise the distance to the nearest bound divided by that bound.

scope_gates.global_scope_warning: A V9C method pass would validate only this published yield-extraction implementation against scalar table values. It would not recreate the missing corrected load channels, validate fracture or contact, identify a CF6-80A2/cowling card, or validate facade, whole-aircraft, global, thermal, Blender, explosive or thermite physics.
